title: Seahawks list Jaxon Smith-Njigba as limited on Monday's practice report

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Seahawks list Jaxon Smith-Njigba as limited on Monday's practice report
sources.description: Seahawks wide receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba stayed in Sunday's loss to the 49ers after having his ankle heavily taped during the first half of the game and the issue landed him on the team's injury report Monday.
